idea-plugin.name: OSGi AI Migrator for Liferay
idea-plugin.description:
AI-assisted modernization of legacy Liferay 7.x OSGi modules into Liferay Objects and Client Extensions, powered by the AI provider you choose: Google Gemini (gcloud ADC, Vertex AI or Google AI Studio), Anthropic Claude, or any OpenAI-compatible server (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio).

Right-click a module in the Project view and choose OSGi AI Migrator → Migrate OSGi Module to Client Extensions... to run a 4-agent pipeline: Donatello analyzes the module, Leonardo designs the target architecture, Michelangelo generates the Batch and React Custom Element client extensions, and Raphael verifies the result before it is written to the Liferay workspace.

Choose and configure the AI provider in Settings → Tools → OSGi AI Migrator for Liferay.
